notes.title: Minda Release!
notes.notes:
Hello! We're happy to announce that Minda is finally released today. Since November 2018, when Minda was first started as a hobby project, Minda took a long way until this point. As this is our first time to release a game to the steam or any other major game platform, we had to think, learn, and work a lot. But, with our burning passion, we were able to come up with this presumable result.

We hope Minda to be a cozy place to play Abalone. Our current focus is on making the game bug-free and fault-tolerant. So, please let us know in the forum if there was something weird happening in the game.
